item.description: Mimo 0.1.11 English New features - Added tiles for streaming and AI endpoint reachability, exit IP information, and IP risk information. - Added local memory, upload, download, and network latency tile templates using the app's existing measurements. - Added Loon installation-link imports and Kelee resource downloads; expanded Surge module routing, managed WebView scripts, and HTTPDNS IP, URL, and User-Agent matching. Major fixes - Fixed a subprocess output-reading race that could unexpectedly terminate the app when a background command finished. - Restore and verify policy selections before enabling enhanced mode to avoid using an unintended node during startup. Performance - Retain visited pages and isolate navigation updates to make sidebar switching smoother. - Prepare Remote Controller tabs ahead of time and reduce page rebuilding on the first switch. Experience improvements - Added compact, customizable tile cards with visible, editable scripts. - Edit remote rewrite modules as local copies while preserving their original sources. Other fixes - Fixed scrolling in the rewrite module source editor. - Restored native sizing for page toolbar actions. - Corrected jq filtering scopes in Coolapk module compatibility. Core update - The bundled mihomo core remains at v1.19.34. 简体中文 新增功能 - 新增流媒体与 AI 入口可达性、出口 IP 信息和 IP 风险信息检测磁贴。 - 新增内存占用、上传流量、下载流量和网络延迟磁贴模板，使用应用已有的实际测量数据。 - 支持导入 Loon 安装链接与下载 Kelee 资源；完善 Surge 模块分流、托管 WebView 脚本，以及 HTTPDNS 的 IP、URL 和 User-Agent 匹配。 重大修复 - 修复后台命令结束时，输出读取竞态可能导致客户端意外退出的问题。 - 开启增强模式前先恢复并校验策略组的节点选择，避免启动期间使用非预期节点。 性能优化 - 保留已访问页面并隔离导航更新，改善侧边栏页面切换流畅度。 - 提前准备远程控制器页签，减少首次切换时的页面重建。 体验改进 - 磁贴卡片支持更紧凑的自定义布局，并可查看和编辑脚本。 - 远程重写模块以本地副本进行编辑，保留原始来源。 常规修复 - 修复重写模块源码编辑器的滚动问题。 - 恢复页面工具栏操作按钮的原生尺寸。 - 修正酷安模块兼容中的 jq 过滤作用域。 内核更新 - 内置 mihomo 版本保持 v1.19.34。

Mimo 0.1.10 English New features - Added Private Network settings with independent Zeno and Tailscale controls, Headscale configuration, and copy actions for the Zeno Peer ID and local subnets. - Expanded proxy editing with Snell v6 and protocol-specific TLS, Reality, ALPN, ECH and advanced fields. - Added image, audio and video previews to capture details. Request and response body retention limits can be set from 1 to 64 MiB per body; the default remains 1 MiB. - Added Surge HTTP module compatibility alongside Loon modules. Major fixes - Fixed rewrite modules not taking effect promptly after reactivation when a browser reused existing connections. - Improved save-failure and quit handling to protect unsaved configuration changes. Performance - Improved Remote Controller Liquid Glass tab switching, live updates, searching and window resizing. - Process configuration saves, certificate checks and favicons in the background. Schedule tiles independently and reuse completed capture details to reduce UI stalls and repeated body loading. Experience improvements - Arrange proxy-node cards in three equal columns that resize with the window. - Save outbound mode, IPv6, DNS and disconnect-on-node-change options per profile. Manage Geo and cache settings across the app. - Remember policy-group display order per profile. Configuration exports preserve remote proxy-set links without bundling downloaded node caches. Other fixes - Fixed Remote Controller column-width persistence. - Fixed failures when closing some connections. - Fixed deleted capture records reappearing after an in-flight refresh. Core update - Updated the bundled mihomo core from v1.19.33 to v1.19.34. 简体中文 新增功能 - 新增「内网互联」，独立配置 Zeno 与 Tailscale，支持 Headscale，可复制 Zeno Peer ID 和本机网段。 - 完善节点编辑器，补齐 Snell v6 及各协议的 TLS、Reality、ALPN、ECH 和高级参数。 - 抓包新增图片、音频和视频预览；每个请求或响应正文的保存上限可设为 1–64 MiB，默认仍为 1 MiB。 - 新增 Surge HTTP 模块兼容，可与 Loon 模块并用。 重大修复 - 修复浏览器复用已有连接时，重新启用重写模块不能及时生效的问题。 - 完善配置保存失败和退出处理，保护尚未保存的修改，避免直接退出丢失草稿。 性能优化 - 优化远程控制器连接／请求／DNS 页签的 Liquid Glass 切换动画、实时刷新、搜索与窗口缩放。 - 配置保存、证书检查和网站图标处理移至后台；磁贴独立调度，已完成的抓包详情复用缓存，减少界面卡顿和正文重复加载。 体验改进 - 节点卡片改为每行三列等宽布局，随窗口宽度伸缩。 - 出站模式、IPv6、DNS 和切换节点断连选项按配置保存；Geo 与缓存设置统一由应用管理。 - 策略组显示顺序按配置记忆；导出配置保留远程代理集链接，不携带已下载的节点缓存。 常规修复 - 修复远程控制器列宽保存不正确的问题。 - 修复部分连接无法关闭的问题。 - 修复清空抓包记录后，旧结果重新出现的问题。 内核更新 - 内置 mihomo 从 v1.19.33 升级至 v1.19.34。

Mimo 0.1.9 English - Added an option to disconnect existing connections when switching proxy nodes from the Proxies page or menu bar. Only connections using the affected policy group are disconnected. This option is off by default. 简体中文 - 新增「切换节点时断开现有连接」。开启后，从代理页或菜单栏切换节点时，只断开经过该策略组的现有连接。此选项默认关闭。
